name: Sailor
ability: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.
interaction: Points to an alive player; the Storyteller decides whether the Sailor or that player is drunk until dusk (choosing self makes the Sailor drunk).
drunk_or_poisoned: Can die, and the choice has no effect.

rulings.text: A sober Sailor executed: announce the execution, they stay alive, no explanation.
If the Sailor picks a Demon, Minion or Outsider, the Storyteller usually makes the Sailor drunk instead.
A drunk Sailor killed by an ability (e.g. Gossip) or executed to prove their claim dies.
Night order numbers are from bra1n/townsquare src/roles.json (develop branch), not the botc-release list.
